critical_code_review_comments: pricing._PRICING_CACHE_TS is refreshed inside the try only when the HTTP call succeeds — if OpenRouter returns non-200 or times out, get_model_pricing keeps retrying every call and blocking each request for up to 20s. Consider setting the timestamp on failure too (or falling back to a shorter retry window) to avoid latency spikes when OpenRouter is down.
backend/main.py is ~1140 lines; if it keeps growing consider splitting message routes and admin routes into separate routers.
